نتواضع (form VI)
# نَتَوَاضَعُ (natawāḍaʕu) /na.ta.waː.dˤa.ʕu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَوَاضَعَ (tawāḍaʕa)
# نَتَوَاضَعَ (natawāḍaʕa) /na.ta.waː.dˤa.ʕa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَوَاضَعَ (tawāḍaʕa)
# نَتَوَاضَعْ (natawāḍaʕ) /na.ta.waː.dˤaʕ/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَوَاضَعَ (tawāḍaʕa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
